disclaimer: Vendor-specific multipliers are estimates. Actual rates depend on configuration, logging level, and traffic volume.

FortiGate syslog tends to be more compact than some NGFW vendors; UTM features and SSL inspection increase volume materially.
ASA-style ACL logging verbosity dominates; FTD with IPS/URL and FMC correlation events adds significant variability.
SmartEvent, HTTPS inspection, and blade-enabled logging materially increase exported log volume.
Session-based syslog tends moderate versus some competitors; AppSecure and UTM features drive the upper range.
Script control, network containment telemetry, and Falcon platform options increase event rates versus baseline EDR.
Advanced hunting, tamper protection, and ASR rule verbosity can lift volume; server workloads often exceed desktops.
Deep Visibility and Ranger network story data can add substantial ancillary events on top of core telemetry.
Enterprise EDR with continuous recording and full process trees trends higher; App Control reduces noise in some estates.
McAfee/Trellix enterprise endpoint telemetry varies widely with policy packs, exploit prevention, and file/registry watchlists.
System Log + fine-grained app assignments and Okta Identity Engine workflows increase authentication-adjacent audit events.
Sign-in and audit logs with CA policies, PIM, and Graph-rich directory changes often produce high sustained volume.
Federate/Access/ping services mix drives variance; token/transaction logging detail is the main lever.
Telephony and telephony-heavy MFA estates can spike authentication telemetry; base Duo logs are lighter than full IdP platforms.
Session recordings, vault access events, and connector/CPM activity typically produce elevated ingest versus SSO-only tools.
CloudTrail organization trails + VPC Flow Logs + GuardDuty/Config significantly increase volume versus control-plane-only logging.
Activity/Diagnostic settings breadth and Defender for Cloud alerts often push Azure estates toward the upper band.
Audit Logs + VPC Flow Logs + SCC findings scale with project fan-out and enabled data access logging.
OCI Audit + VCN Flow Logs + Cloud Guard; volume scales with compartment structure and enabled services.
Activity Tracker events plus VPC flow and platform services vary with account topology and enabled integrations.
Nessus/T.sc with asset discovery, agent telemetry, and web-app scanning modules increases exported finding and job detail.
Cloud Agent + passive scanner and WAS can add continuous streams beyond scheduled scan summaries.
InsightVM/Agent with remediation ticketing and integration sprawl often correlates with richer exported change/finding events.
Bundled with M365/Defender stack; ingest often lower than standalone VM suites but scales with endpoint breadth.
Cloud-native graph inventory plus continuous posture events can be chatty in large multi-account estates.
Web logs, firewall, DNS, and DLP forwarding granularity (NSS/CBI) are the primary volume drivers.
SSE with CASB/SWG + granular SaaS transaction detail often trends toward higher sustained web/SaaS telemetry.
DNS-centric logging is often lighter than full proxy payloads; Secure Internet Gateway features increase detail.
Remote user traffic inspection and threat/url logging mirror NG firewall-like volume scaled by user concurrency.
Gateway/Zero Trust logs vary widely: DNS-only estates skew low; full HTTP inspection and PCAP-adjacent features skew high.
Unified Audit Trail, fine-grained auditing, and redo-heavy environments can generate very high audit/log volume.
Extended Events vs. SQL Audit vs. heavy DDL/DML auditing dominates variability; Always On replicas can multiply streams.
pg_audit and statement logging are the main levers; default configurations are often leaner than commercial suites.
General/slow query logs and audit plugins range from minimal to very verbose depending on compliance mode.
Auditing, profiler, and change streams can scale sharply with high document churn and sharded clusters.
ONTAP EMS/autosupport-style telemetry and per-volume auditing increase with multi-protocol and MetroCluster estates.
PowerStore/PowerMax/Unisphere exports vary by array family; VPLEX/RecoverPoint adjacency can add integration log sprawl.
Generally streamlined management APIs/logs; FlashArray/FlashBlade telemetry increases with replication and workload intensity.
Alletra/3PAR/Nimble families differ; SSMC/InfoSight integrations and replication events affect exported detail.
Spectrum Virtualize/FlashSystem event streams scale with cluster size and copy services activity.
Asset and anomaly detections scale with monitored segments and protocol depth; span/mirror placement affects event richness.
Deep DPI across diverse OT protocols and integration fan-out can produce sustained medium-high telemetry.
Collection platform density and ICS-specific analytics often correlate with higher exported detection narratives.
PlantPAx/FactoryTalk and Stratix switching environments vary; controller and HMI logging verbosity drives spread.
SIMATIC/TIA and industrial comms monitoring scale with cell/line complexity and security module enablement.
Model-driven detections and explanatory metadata can be voluminous versus flow-only sensors.
L7 payload analysis and decryption options materially increase exported event detail.
Cognito detections plus metadata exports scale with east-west coverage and SaaS/identity detect modules.
Zeek-derived logs scale with link speed, SSL inspection policy, and enabled log suites (files/DNS/HTTP richness).
Former Stealthwatch; NetFlow/IPFIX-centric baselining is often lighter than full PCAP-adjacent NDR but still bandwidth-sensitive.
Message trace, Advanced Auditing, Defender for Office 365, and transport agent detail can dominate mail telemetry volume.
Tap syslog/SIEM exports vary with TAP depth, URL rewrite logging, and attachment analytics enabled.
Journal and SMTP transaction logging settings drive most variance; impersonation and URL protect events add volume.
Gateway syslog formats differ by appliance generation; ATP and sandbox detail increase sustained events.
Text mail logs vs. injection/debug and AMP retrospection logging materially change daily exported volume.
